Done. Summary of changes:

- Added `createVisualBlocksFooterPlugin`/`VISUALBLOCKS_FOOTER_PLUGIN_NAME`/`VISUALBLOCKS_FOOTER_STATUSBAR_NAME` in [renderers/tinymce/src/plugins/visualblocks-footer.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/plugins/visualblocks-footer.ts), mirroring the existing fullscreen/searchreplace footer wrappers since [TinyMCE's visualblocks plugin](https://www.tiny.cloud/docs/tinymce/latest/visualblocks/) only ships a toolbar toggle.
- Exported it from [renderers/tinymce/src/index.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/index.ts) and added [renderers/tinymce/tests/visualblocks-footer.test.ts](renderers/tinymce/tests/visualblocks-footer.test.ts).
- Wired it into the canvas-theme-editor scaffold template ([packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/main.ts.tmpl](packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/main.ts.tmpl)): imports `tinymce/plugins/visualblocks`, registers the footer plugin, and adds both plugin names to the `plugins` init string, so the "Show blocks" toggle appears in the footer alongside a11y/word count/fullscreen/find-and-replace.
- Regenerated `packages/scaffold/generated/scaffolds.ts` via `vp run generate` and fixed the now-stale plugins-string assertion in [packages/scaffold/tests/index.test.ts](packages/scaffold/tests/index.test.ts).
- Added a changeset.

Two unrelated pre-existing test failures were found (a stale toolbar-string assertion in scaffold's `index.test.ts` and a quote-style mismatch in `renderers/tinymce/tests/skins.test.ts`) — confirmed via `git stash` that both predate this change, so I left them alone.
